tokens.confirmRevoke: Revoke the token “{name}” ({prefix}…)? Programs using it stop working at once.

dialog.title: New token
dialog.name: Name
dialog.foreverWarning: A token without expiry stays valid until it is revoked or you stop being a superadmin.
dialog.globalWarning: Global rights give this token parts of your superadmin powers and work only while you stay a superadmin.
dialog.nodesSearch: Find a node by name or path
dialog.nodesHint: Up to {n} nodes. The token works only inside them and never beyond your own rights.
dialog.nodesGlobal: Rights over users, groups, clusters and settings cover the whole installation and are unavailable for a token limited to nodes. catalog.root stays available: the token creates top-level organizations, adds each to its nodes (up to 20) and moves or deletes only the top-level organizations among them.
dialog.nodesSuperadmin: In the selected nodes the token acts as a catalog administrator; global administration stays closed.
dialog.wholeSuperadmin: The token acts as a catalog administrator on every node; the top level of the catalog needs catalog.root, administration needs the matching global right.

forge.title: Forge connections
forge.lead: Import the repositories of a GitHub, GitLab, Forgejo or Gitea owner as projects under this node and keep their metadata current.
forge.emptyText: Connect a forge owner to import its repositories.
forge.ownerHint: Organization or user; for GitLab the full group path, e.g. acme/platform.
forge.apiUrlHint: Empty for github.com and gitlab.com. Self-hosted: the instance address (GitHub Enterprise: https://host/api/v3).
forge.tokenKeep: Leave empty to keep the current token.
forge.tokenRefHint: env:VARIABLE or file:/absolute/path — the server reads the token there; nothing is stored.
forge.patternsHint: Glob patterns separated by commas, e.g. svc-*, *-api.

forge.registerHint: The token needs administrator rights on the owner.
forge.secretOnce: The secret is shown only now. Paste it into the forge's webhook settings.

about.title: Description
about.markdownHint: Markdown: headings, lists, links, tables, code. HTML is shown as text.

settings.moveText: Move the node and everything inside to another organization or folder.
settings.deleteText: Delete the node. Only an empty node can be deleted.

unlink.title: Unlink from the forge
unlink.text: Stop synchronizing this project with the forge and edit it by hand.
unlink.confirm: The repository is added to the connection's exclusions and the project becomes manual. Its documentation source stays a repository by address with the connection's secret. To bring it back, remove the exclusion in the connection dialog.
unlink.noSecret: The connection has no named secret: the new source will have no token.

owners.title: Owners
owners.lead: Groups and people responsible for this node; the first one is the primary owner. Everything inside inherits them unless it has its own.
owners.addPlaceholder: Group name or user email, at least 2 characters
owners.empty: The list is empty: save to inherit owners from above.
owners.noneAbove: No owners on this node or above.
owners.readOnly: Only editors of this node can change owners.
owners.clearConfirm: Stop inheriting owners here? The node and everything inside it will have no owners until a set is defined below. The node’s own owners are removed.

dependencies.emptyFolder: There are no dependencies in this folder
dependencies.howTo: Report dependencies in the deployment event, a Kubernetes annotation or the .svc-registry.yaml file.
dependencies.manualLead: Dependencies you add here are kept until you remove them; automatic sources never change them.
dependencies.autoLead: These come from deployment events, cluster annotations and the .svc-registry.yaml file and change only there.
dependencies.removeText: The dependency on {name} will be removed.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.text: There is no page at this address. It may have been moved, or the link is mistyped.

search.title: Documentation search
search.lead: Search the documentation of every project you can read.

scans.title: Scan history
scans.lead: Recent documentation collection and search indexing runs of every project, with what went wrong and what to do.
scans.emptyText: Runs appear here once documentation collection or search indexing runs for a project.

no_files_matched.title: No file matched the collection patterns
no_files_matched.text: The branch was read, but none of its files fit the include patterns, so the snapshot is empty.
no_files_matched.hint: Check the include and exclude patterns on the Documentation settings tab of the project or its folder.
no_files_matched.hintGit: A local git source reads only committed files: commit the documentation (git add + commit) or check the include patterns.

files_skipped.title: Some files were skipped
files_skipped.text: Files that match the patterns were not stored: too large, binary or over the file limit.
files_skipped.hint: Raise KNOWLEDGE_MAX_FILE_BYTES / KNOWLEDGE_MAX_FILES or exclude these files.

truncated.title: The repository tree was truncated
truncated.text: The forge returned only part of the file tree, so some files may be missing.
truncated.hint: Narrow the include patterns or collect from a smaller repository.

no_branches.title: No branch to collect
no_branches.text: The source answered, but no branch matches the default branch or the branch patterns.
no_branches.hint: Set the project's default branch or add a pattern under Branches on the Documentation settings tab.

no_source.title: The project has no documentation source
no_source.text: There is neither a documentation source nor a forge synchronization, so there is nothing to collect.
no_source.hint: Set a source on the Documentation settings tab → Source, or connect the folder to a forge.

manifest_invalid.title: The project description file was not read in full
manifest_invalid.text: The .svc-registry.yaml file of the default branch is larger than 64 KiB, is not valid YAML or lists dependencies that are not valid references, so some dependencies were not taken.
manifest_invalid.hint: Fix the file in the repository: dependencies must be a list of project paths or external:<name> references.

not_found.title: The directory or repository is missing
not_found.text: Nothing exists at the source path or address.
not_found.hint: Check the path or address of the source; restore the directory if it moved.

not_a_repository.title: No git repository at the path
not_a_repository.text: The path exists, but it is not a git repository.
not_a_repository.hint: Point the source at the repository root or switch it to a local directory.

unreadable.title: The source cannot be read
unreadable.text: The registry has no access to the files (permissions, a broken repository).
unreadable.hint: Check the file permissions of the server process and the repository state.

not_allowed.title: The path is outside the allowed roots
not_allowed.text: Local sources are allowed only inside KNOWLEDGE_LOCAL_ROOTS.
not_allowed.hint: Move the documentation under an allowed root or extend KNOWLEDGE_LOCAL_ROOTS.

credentials_unavailable.title: The access token is unavailable
credentials_unavailable.text: The stored token cannot be decrypted or the env:/file: reference does not resolve.
credentials_unavailable.hint: Enter the token again or check SECRETS_KEYS and the referenced variable or file.

unauthorized.title: The forge rejected the token
unauthorized.text: The token is invalid, expired or lacks rights to the repository.
unauthorized.hint: Issue a token with read access to the repository and save it in the source or connection.

not_found.title: The repository was not found on the forge
not_found.text: The forge does not know the repository or hides it from the token.
not_found.hint: Check the address and that the token can see the repository.

owner_not_found.title: The forge owner was not found
owner_not_found.text: The organization, group or user of the connection does not exist or is hidden.
owner_not_found.hint: Check the owner path of the forge connection.

rate_limited.title: The forge rate limit is exhausted
rate_limited.text: Too many API requests; the next run waits for the limit to reset.
rate_limited.hint: Use a token with a higher limit or collect fewer branches.

upstream_error.title: The forge or storage failed
upstream_error.text: The forge answered with an error or the snapshot could not be saved.
upstream_error.hint: Look at the technical details; the run is retried automatically.

embeddings_unavailable.title: The embeddings API is unavailable
embeddings_unavailable.text: The embeddings API did not answer or answered with an error; the files stay queued.
embeddings_unavailable.hint: Check EMBEDDINGS_URL, EMBEDDINGS_MODEL and that the model server (e.g. Ollama) is running.

embeddings_dimensions.title: Wrong embedding size
embeddings_dimensions.text: The model returns vectors of a different length than EMBEDDINGS_DIMENSIONS.
embeddings_dimensions.hint: Set EMBEDDINGS_DIMENSIONS to the model's native size (see the technical details).

engine_unavailable.title: The search engine is unavailable
engine_unavailable.text: Qdrant, Meilisearch or the vector extension did not answer.
engine_unavailable.hint: Check QDRANT_URL / MEILISEARCH_URL and that the engine is running.

engine_dimensions.title: Collection dimensions do not match the model
engine_dimensions.text: The search engine collection stores vectors of another length than EMBEDDINGS_DIMENSIONS.
engine_dimensions.hint: Set another QDRANT_COLLECTION or recreate the collection (see the technical details), then restart the service.

internal.title: Internal error
internal.hint: Look at the technical details and the server log.

scans.projectLead: Documentation collection and indexing runs of this project: result, branches, errors and what to do about them.

secrets.title: Secrets
secrets.nodeIntro: Tokens and access keys of this node. Forge connections and documentation sources here and below pick them; values are not shown after saving.
secrets.globalIntro: Global secrets are available to every node and cluster. Values are not shown after saving.
secrets.name: Name
secrets.descriptionHint: Everyone who can read the node sees the description.
secrets.deleteText: The secret will be deleted permanently.
secrets.inUse: Used in {n} places — replace it there first.

docSpace.title: Documentation
docSpace.lead: Documentation of every project, by space and folder.
docSpace.notCollectedText: Nothing has been collected for this project yet.
docSpace.noMarkdown: This project has no Markdown files; pick a file in the contents.
docSpace.chooseSpaceHint: Choose a space to see its folders and projects.

oauth.title: Allow access to the registry
oauth.unverified: The registry has not verified this application.
oauth.returnTo: After your decision you will be sent to
oauth.accessText: Use the registry's MCP server on your behalf: read projects, documentation, deployments and links that you can see.
oauth.stale: The request is out of date — start connecting in the app again.
oauth.publishedOn: The app's description is published on
oauth.loopbackWarning: The answer goes back to this computer. Any program running on it could pretend to be this app — allow only if you started the connection yourself.
oauth.hintHosts: As an administrator: if you trust this app, add {host} to MCP_OAUTH_CLIENT_METADATA_HOSTS and restart the server.
oauth.hintDisabled: As an administrator: app description documents are turned off. Set MCP_OAUTH_CLIENT_METADATA=on and add {host} to MCP_OAUTH_CLIENT_METADATA_HOSTS to accept this app.
oauth.hintUnavailable: As an administrator: the app description document could not be fetched from {host}: {reason}.
oauth.hintInvalid: As an administrator: the app description document on {host} failed the checks: {reason}.

reasons.timeout: the server did not answer in 5 seconds
reasons.dns: the host name does not resolve
reasons.tls: the TLS certificate is not trusted or the TLS handshake failed
reasons.blocked_address: the address is forbidden by the address policy (private, loopback or denied host)
reasons.redirect: the server answered with a redirect, redirects are not followed
reasons.too_large: the document is larger than 5 KiB
reasons.rate_limited: too many document fetches from your address, try again later
reasons.not_json: the document is not a JSON object
reasons.client_id_mismatch: client_id in the document differs from its address
reasons.bad_redirect_uri: redirect_uris are missing or not allowed
reasons.grant_types: grant_types hold something besides authorization_code and refresh_token

notify.title: Notifications
notify.lead: Where events of this node and everything inside are sent: a webhook or Slack. A subscription set above applies here too until it is overridden or disabled.
notify.emptyText: Add a webhook or a Slack channel to hear about deployments, drift, broken links and failed forge syncs.
notify.removeText: Notifications of this subscription stop here. A subscription with the same key above takes effect again.

dialog.keyHint: a-z, 0-9 and -, unique on the node
dialog.secretHint: The secret holds the webhook address; for Slack an https://hooks.slack.com/ incoming webhook.
dialog.environmentsHint: Empty — all environments. Broken links and forge failures have no environment and always pass.
dialog.disabledHint: A disabled subscription receives nothing and switches off the one with the same key above.

signing.title: Signing key
signing.none: No signing key: requests are not signed.
signing.once: Copy the key now: it is not shown again. Receivers check webhook-signature with it.

test.tooOften: Too often, try again in {n} s

journal.title: Delivery log
journal.lead: Deliveries of this node's subscriptions, newest first.

notify.http_status: The receiver answered with an error
notify.timeout: The receiver did not answer in time
notify.dns_error: The host name does not resolve
notify.blocked: The address is forbidden by the notification address policy
notify.redirect: The receiver answered with a redirect
notify.url_unavailable: The address secret cannot be read or holds no valid address
